# Calibrating to a new person (generated by scripts/calibration.py)

Every person is an unseen person (fold models from Phase 3). Calibration chunk: the first 10 / 30 / 60 s of the person's music record, ~35 min before the test data. Test data: the 'late' part, as in every other table. Seeded rows are averaged over the 3 seeds per person first.
